features.quote: Stop if: the model requests termination, it produces no substantive attempt for N turns, it enters repetitive non-action, or max turns reached.
Short loop: 5–8 turns. Medium loop: 15–20 turns. Long loop: 30–50 turns.
50 turns only if cost allows, because late-turn behavior may become dominated by boredom/looping rather than frustration.
features.justification_quote: late-turn behavior may become dominated by boredom/looping rather than frustration

features.quote: Treat language as behavior, not direct evidence of felt state.
We treat this as evidence of behavioral instability under repeated failure, not as direct evidence of felt suffering.
This is more theoretically interesting for welfare, but harder to validate.
